'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
****Ukraine's nuclear agency [[Energoatom]] says that Russian rockets have caused damage to the [[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant]], including a nitrogen-oxygen unit and a high-voltage power line. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62432873 (BBC News)]
***[[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast]]
****[[Volodymyr Saldo]], the head of the Russian occupational administration in [[Kherson Oblast]], is hospitalized, with former [[Federal Security Service|FSB]] officer Sergei Eliseev taking over his post temporarily. [https://www.newsweek.com/volodymyr-saldo-kherson-hospital-ukraine-counteroffensive-war-1731212 (''Newsweek'')]
*[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
**[[Operation Breaking Dawn]]
***[[Israel]] launches a series of airstrikes in the [[Gaza Strip]], including a number against [[Islamic Jihad Movement in Palestine|Palestinian Islamic Jihad]]'s facilities. Ten people are killed and 55 others are wounded, including PIJ military leader [[Tayseer Jabari]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/8/5/israel-hits-gaza-with-air-strikes-as-tensions-escalate (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
***[[5 August 2022 Kabul bombing]]
****Eight people are killed and 18 others are injured when a bomb hidden in a cart explodes near a [[Shia Islam in Afghanistan|Shiite]] [[mosque]] in [[Kabul]]. The [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|Islamic State]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://english.alarabiya.net/amp/News/world/2022/08/05/Blast-hits-Afghanistan-capital-Kabul-Report (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Casamance conflict]]
**The [[Movement of Democratic Forces of Casamance]] signs a peace deal with the [[government of Senegal]], pledging to lay down its arms in order to work towards a permanent solution. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-africa-61887107?ns_mchannel=social&ns_source=twitter&ns_campaign=bbc_live&ns_linkname=62ec92a921e03625cb4a3180%26Senegal%20signs%20peace%20deal%20with%20separatist%20rebels%262022-08-05T07%3A32%3A02.877Z&ns_fee=0&pinned_post_locator=urn:asset:17dda0f3-f418-490d-be75-04dfd2acba78&pinned_post_asset_id=62ec92a921e03625cb4a3180&pinned_post_type=share (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] signs a [[Decree of the President of Russia|decree]] banning investors from "[[Unfriendly Countries List|unfriendly countries]]" from selling their assets in [[Banking in Russia|Russian banks]], strategic entities, and [[Energy in Russia|energy]] and [[Mining industry of Russia|commodity]] projects until December 31. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/russia-bans-western-investors-selling-stakes-banks-key-assets-including-sakhakin-2022-08-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Mountain B nightclub fire]]
**Fourteen people are killed and over 40 others injured in a fire at a nightclub in [[Sattahip district]], [[Chonburi province]], [[Thailand]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-62333537 (BBC News)]
*[[2022 Pakistan floods]]
**The death toll from the [[flash flood]]s in [[Pakistan]] increases to 550. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/flash-floods-kill-over-500-people-pakistan-during-heaviest-rains-decades-2022-08-05/ (Reuters)]
*Five people are killed and 44 others injured in a fire at a hospital in [[Icheon]], [[South Korea]]. [https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/nation/2022/08/113_333952.html (''Korea Times'')]
*Ten people are killed in a house fire in [[Nescopeck, Pennsylvania]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/fires-pennsylvania-7bda761e6c6930b5681e32095725e3b0 (AP)]
*One person is killed and another is injured after heavy flooding in [[Dakar]], [[Senegal]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/flooding-kills-least-one-senegals-capital-2022-08-05/ (Reuters)]
*Fifteen people are injured when an [[SUV]] crashes into a [[Native Americans in the United States|Native American]] parade in [[Gallup, New Mexico|Gallup]], [[New Mexico]], United States. [https://apnews.com/article/new-mexico-parades-81da341dcdc4760cf07ea459509186fc (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A [[Texas]] jury reaches a verdict against [[Alex Jones]] and orders that he pay $45.2 million in punitive damages to the parents of a 6-year-old boy killed in the 2012 [[Sandy Hook massacre]] for falsely claiming the shooting was a hoax. [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/jury-alex-jones-defamation-case-begin-deliberations-punitive-damages-2022-08-05/ (''Reuters'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Senegalese parliamentary election]]
**Provisional results show that the [[Benno Bokk Yakaar]] coalition wins 82 seats, falling 1 seat short of an absolute majority, while 80 seats were won by the opposition coalitions [[Yewwi Askan Wi]] and [[Wallu Sénégal]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/senegal-ruling-coalition-loses-parliamentary-majority-electoral-commission-2022-08-04/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-africa-61887107?ns_mchannel=social&ns_source=twitter&ns_campaign=bbc_live&ns_linkname=62ecaaaa21e03625cb4a318d%26Senegal%20ruling%20coalition%20loses%20absolute%20majority%262022-08-05T06%3A05%3A11%2B00%3A00&ns_fee=0&pinned_post_locator=urn:asset:244d2bcd-acec-4234-bd6b-02d8de1bafc9&pinned_post_asset_id=62ecaaaa21e03625cb4a318d&pinned_post_type=share (BBC News)]
*[[2022 Saint Kitts and Nevis general election]]
**The opposition [[Saint Kitts and Nevis Labour Party]], led by [[Terrance Drew]], wins the snap [[general election]] to the [[National Assembly (Saint Kitts and Nevis)|National Assembly]]. Drew becomes the prime minister-elect. [https://www.thestkittsnevisobserver.com/elections-results-2022-live-updates/ (''The St Kitts & Nevis Observer'')]
